Name: Amraphel
Summary: Amraphel was the king of Shinar who joined Chedorlaomer's alliance against the cities of the plain.
KeyStory: Amraphel marched with three other kings, defeated Sodom and Gomorrah, and carried off Lot — until Abram rescued him.
LifeLesson: Empires rise and fall, but God's promise to Abram outlasted every king of his day.
